decisions.reason: As a very recent launch in the firm's core dumper range with visible public presentation and clear fit to its established engineering and service capabilities, management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course quickly.

Because this articulated construction dumper extends the established offer, draws on existing know-how and channels, and reflects a fresh public commitment, the firm would be inclined to persist with it despite any early-market uncertainty.

Although the underground mine rescue vehicle is farther from the firm's core range and therefore more exposed if uptake disappoints, the recent development effort, public launch and tendency to justify prior investment still make continuation more likely than withdrawal in 2024.

This compact telescopic loader is close to the firm's existing business and strategic direction, so sunk development costs, reputational commitment and expected synergies with service and parts support all favor keeping it on the market.
